article.title: Imperialism turns El Niño into mass death
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The last El Niño anywhere near this strong came in 1877. It set off famines that killed tens of millions of people across India, China and Brazil. The post Imperialism turns El Niño into mass death appeared first on MR Online .
